lines.speaker: YOU

lines.text: This is MY server! How did this even HAPPEN?!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR

lines.text: Well. It all started with a family breakfast.

lines.text: This is you. In real life, you're just a kid. But in Cube City... you're a legend.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Level ninety-nine. The best base in Tycoon Valley. Two thousand wins in the arena.
lines.text: Level ninety-nine. The best base in Tycoon Valley. Two thousand wins in the arena.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [proud] Two thousand and ONE.
lines.text: Two thousand and ONE.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [showing off] Welcome to my castle. [pause] Lava pool. Trophy room. [pause] And this... is my throne.
lines.text: Welcome to my castle. Lava pool. Trophy room. And this... is my throne.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [deadpan] The throne was just a chair. [pause] A very expensive chair.
lines.text: The throne was just a chair. A very expensive chair.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: That's Noodle. Your best friend. You've never met in real life... [pause] but you've beaten four hundred bosses together.
lines.text: That's Noodle. Your best friend. You've never met in real life... but you've beaten four hundred bosses together.

lines.raw: [excited] Bro! Bro, bro, bro! New update! [pause] The Block King is coming!
lines.text: Bro! Bro, bro, bro! New update! The Block King is coming!

lines.text: And that's DarkBlade. Nobody knows who he really is. Nobody knows why he's always so angry.

lines.raw: [edgy, slow] You got lucky last time, YOU. [pause] Enjoy your little castle.
lines.text: You got lucky last time, YOU. Enjoy your little castle.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [smug] Enjoy your little losing streak.
lines.text: Enjoy your little losing streak.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: But on Saturday morning... real life happened.
lines.text: But on Saturday morning... real life happened.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: There's Dad. An accountant. He thinks every video game is called "the Nintendo."
lines.text: There's Dad. An accountant. He thinks every video game is called "the Nintendo."

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: There's Mom. A very quiet librarian. [pause] She says "shh" more than any other word.
lines.text: There's Mom. A very quiet librarian. She says "shh" more than any other word.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: And there's Granny. She knits. She bakes. [pause] And she has never lost an argument in her life.
lines.text: And there's Granny. She knits. She bakes. And she has never lost an argument in her life.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [cheerful] Family meeting! [pause] Your mother and I have noticed you spend eleven hours a day in... the Nintendo.
lines.text: Family meeting! Your mother and I have noticed you spend eleven hours a day in... the Nintendo.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [annoyed] It's not a Nintendo, Dad. It's Cube City.
lines.text: It's not a Nintendo, Dad. It's Cube City.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [calm, firm] So we made a decision. [pause] Tonight is Family Game Night.
lines.text: So we made a decision. Tonight is Family Game Night.

lines.speaker: YOU

lines.text: Oh. Board games. Okay, that's fine—

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [sweetly] No, dear. [pause] We're joining YOUR game.
lines.text: No, dear. We're joining YOUR game.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [horrified] You're joining... my SERVER?!
lines.text: You're joining... my SERVER?!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [deadpan] It was the scariest sentence you had ever heard.
lines.text: It was the scariest sentence you had ever heard.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: That evening, the living room turned into a gaming setup. [pause] Kind of.
lines.text: That evening, the living room turned into a gaming setup. Kind of.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [squinting] Okay. Username. [pause] D... A... D... [pause] Where's the B?
lines.text: Okay. Username. D... A... D... Where's the B?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [impatient] Dad, it's RIGHT there!
lines.text: Dad, it's RIGHT there!

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [proud] Got it! "DadBod nineteen seventy-eight."
lines.text: Got it! "DadBod nineteen seventy-eight."

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [groans] Why would you tell everyone your age?!
lines.text: Why would you tell everyone your age?!

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [proudly] And for the password... [pause] "password."
lines.text: And for the password... "password."

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [facepalm] Dad. NO.
lines.text: Dad. NO.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Then Dad went to the avatar shop. [pause] And he clicked... everything.
lines.text: Then Dad went to the avatar shop. And he clicked... everything.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [confused] Son... why am I a hot dog?
lines.text: Son... why am I a hot dog?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [deadpan] I don't know, Dad. You did that.
lines.text: I don't know, Dad. You did that.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [warming up] You know what? [pause] I like it. I'm keeping it.
lines.text: You know what? I like it. I'm keeping it.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [calm] I'm not really a gamer, sweetie. [pause] I'll just watch.
lines.text: I'm not really a gamer, sweetie. I'll just watch.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [confused] Mom... you're completely grey.
lines.text: Mom... you're completely grey.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [calm] Grey is classy, sweetie.
lines.text: Grey is classy, sweetie.

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [loudly, into the phone] HELLO, PHONE. [pause] MAKE ME. A GAME. PERSON.
lines.text: HELLO, PHONE. MAKE ME. A GAME. PERSON.

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [confused] Which button is "go"? [pause] Oh! I bought something.
lines.text: Which button is "go"? Oh! I bought something.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Granny pressed buttons at random... and somehow ended up looking like a billionaire.
lines.text: Granny pressed buttons at random... and somehow ended up looking like a billionaire.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [defeated] Okay. Rule number one. [pause] Do NOT talk to my friends.
lines.text: Okay. Rule number one. Do NOT talk to my friends.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [cheerfully] Got it, champ!
lines.text: Got it, champ!

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [cheerful] DadBod1978 joined the server. [pause] MOM_OFFICIAL joined the server. [pause] GrannyGoodies joined the server.
lines.text: DadBod1978 joined the server. MOM_OFFICIAL joined the server. GrannyGoodies joined the server.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: The whole server saw it. [pause] Every. Single. Name.
lines.text: The whole server saw it. Every. Single. Name.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [loud, typing slowly] HELLO SON. [pause] IT IS DAD. [pause] LOVE, DAD.
lines.text: HELLO SON. IT IS DAD. LOVE, DAD.

lines.speaker: NOODLE
lines.raw: [laughing] Bro... is that your DAD?!
lines.text: Bro... is that your DAD?!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [whispering, panicked] Rule number one, Dad! RULE NUMBER ONE!
lines.text: Rule number one, Dad! RULE NUMBER ONE!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Then Mom found the emote button.
lines.text: Then Mom found the emote button.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [sweetly] Mwah! [pause] Love you, honey!
lines.text: Mwah! Love you, honey!

lines.speaker: DARKBLADE
lines.raw: [mocking] Ha! The legend brought his MOMMY.
lines.text: Ha! The legend brought his MOMMY.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [determined] Don't worry, son. Dad's got this. [pause] How do I jump?
lines.text: Don't worry, son. Dad's got this. How do I jump?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [whisper-shouting] Spacebar!
lines.text: Spacebar!

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [shouting at the screen] SPACE! [pause] BAR!
lines.text: SPACE! BAR!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [deadpan] He did not press the spacebar. [pause] He said it. Very loudly. To the computer.
lines.text: He did not press the spacebar. He said it. Very loudly. To the computer.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [typing slowly] DEAR EVERYONE. [pause] WHERE IS THE JUMP BUTTON.
lines.text: DEAR EVERYONE. WHERE IS THE JUMP BUTTON.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Fifty players answered at the same time. [pause] Fifty players said "SPACEBAR."
lines.text: Fifty players answered at the same time. Fifty players said "SPACEBAR."

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [whispering] Nobody look at me. [pause] I'm a tree. I'm a tree.
lines.text: Nobody look at me. I'm a tree. I'm a tree.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [quickly] Okay! You guys... stay here! Practice jumping! [pause] I'll be in the arena!
lines.text: Okay! You guys... stay here! Practice jumping! I'll be in the arena!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You ran to the Battle Arena, where nobody could embarrass you. [pause] But Mom followed you.
lines.text: You ran to the Battle Arena, where nobody could embarrass you. But Mom followed you.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [calm] Don't mind me, sweetie. I'm just watching.
lines.text: Don't mind me, sweetie. I'm just watching.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Then someone hit Mom with a sword. [pause] And Mom... hit back.
lines.text: Then someone hit Mom with a sword. And Mom... hit back.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [stunned] Mom... how did you DO that?
lines.text: Mom... how did you DO that?

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [modest] Oh. Muscle memory.
lines.text: Oh. Muscle memory.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: That's when you learned the truth. [pause] In nineteen ninety-eight, your mom was the arcade champion of the whole state.
lines.text: That's when you learned the truth. In nineteen ninety-eight, your mom was the arcade champion of the whole state.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [laughing softly] They called me "The Queen." [pause] I retired. For you.
lines.text: They called me "The Queen." I retired. For you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Ten minutes later... she was number one on the leaderboard.
lines.text: Ten minutes later... she was number one on the leaderboard.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [sweetly] Nice try, honey! [pause] Sit up straight! [pause] Did you eat breakfast?
lines.text: Nice try, honey! Sit up straight! Did you eat breakfast?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: She defeated a hundred players. [pause] And she made sure every single one of them was hydrated.
lines.text: She defeated a hundred players. And she made sure every single one of them was hydrated.

lines.speaker: DARKBLADE
lines.raw: [angry] One on one, Mom! [pause] Right now!
lines.text: One on one, Mom! Right now!

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [sweetly] Okay, sweetie.
lines.text: Okay, sweetie.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [kind] Good game! [pause] Don't forget to stretch!
lines.text: Good game! Don't forget to stretch!

lines.raw: [screaming] YOUR MOM IS A LEGEND!
lines.text: YOUR MOM IS A LEGEND!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [quietly] ...I'm the legend.
lines.text: ...I'm the legend.

lines.raw: Meanwhile, Granny opened a cookie stand. [pause] Just a little one.
lines.text: Meanwhile, Granny opened a cookie stand. Just a little one.

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [sweet] Fresh cookies! Two coins! [pause] Three for the cute ones!
lines.text: Fresh cookies! Two coins! Three for the cute ones!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Then a bakery. Then a factory. [pause] Then a skyscraper.
lines.text: Then a bakery. Then a factory. Then a skyscraper.

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [sweetly] Cookies are now five coins. [pause] Ten coins on weekends. [pause] Fifteen if you're rude.
lines.text: Cookies are now five coins. Ten coins on weekends. Fifteen if you're rude.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: She hired your friends. [pause] Then she hired your friends' friends.
lines.text: She hired your friends. Then she hired your friends' friends.

lines.speaker: NOODLE
lines.raw: [cheerful] Sorry, bro! She pays double! [pause] And there's dental!
lines.text: Sorry, bro! She pays double! And there's dental!

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [sweetly] I bought your castle, dear. [pause] It was a very good deal.
lines.text: I bought your castle, dear. It was a very good deal.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [shocked] You BOUGHT my base?!
lines.text: You BOUGHT my base?!

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [sweet, firm] You can still live there. [pause] Rent is fifty coins a week.
lines.text: You can still live there. Rent is fifty coins a week.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [pleading] Granny! I'm your grandson!
lines.text: Granny! I'm your grandson!

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [sweetly] That's why it's only fifty, dear.
lines.text: That's why it's only fifty, dear.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [deadpan] You had twelve coins.
lines.text: You had twelve coins.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: And Dad? [pause] Dad was still trying the first jump. [pause] For almost three hours.
lines.text: And Dad? Dad was still trying the first jump. For almost three hours.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [determined] Okay. Space... bar. [pause] Space... BAR!
lines.text: Okay. Space... bar. Space... BAR!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: But then something strange happened. [pause] The new players... started gathering around him.
lines.text: But then something strange happened. The new players... started gathering around him.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [warm, encouraging] You can do it, kiddo! [pause] I believe in you! [pause] I don't believe in ME... but I believe in you!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: He cheered for every jump. [pause] He told terrible jokes.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [proud] Why did the noob cross the road? [pause] He couldn't! He was stuck in the lobby! [pause] Like me!
lines.text: Why did the noob cross the road? He couldn't! He was stuck in the lobby! Like me!

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [inspiring] Listen up, kids! [pause] Falling is not failing! [pause] Failing is when you stop trying! [pause] I fell two hundred times today!
lines.text: Listen up, kids! Falling is not failing! Failing is when you stop trying! I fell two hundred times today!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: By sunset... the whole server was calling him "Dad."
lines.text: By sunset... the whole server was calling him "Dad."

lines.speaker: KID
lines.raw: [shy] Mister Hot Dog? [pause] Can you be my dad too?
lines.text: Mister Hot Dog? Can you be my dad too?

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [touched] Of course, kiddo. [pause] Everybody gets a dad today!
lines.text: Of course, kiddo. Everybody gets a dad today!

lines.speaker: NOODLE
lines.raw: [happy] Your dad is so cool, bro. [pause] My dad never plays with me.
lines.text: Your dad is so cool, bro. My dad never plays with me.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [quietly, jealous] ...He's MY dad.
lines.text: ...He's MY dad.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Your mom was the best fighter. Your granny was the richest player. [pause] Your dad was everyone's favorite.
lines.text: Your mom was the best fighter. Your granny was the richest player. Your dad was everyone's favorite.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [quietly] And you... were just "the son."
lines.text: And you... were just "the son."

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [angry] This is MY game! My friends! My server! [pause] You're taking EVERYTHING!
lines.text: This is MY game! My friends! My server! You're taking EVERYTHING!

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [surprised, soft] Sweetie...
lines.text: Sweetie...

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [shouting] I wish you never joined!
lines.text: I wish you never joined!

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [quietly] Maybe we pushed too hard.
lines.text: Maybe we pushed too hard.

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [softly] Go talk to him, dear. [pause] Not you. [pause] Him.
lines.text: Go talk to him, dear. Not you. Him.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [softly] Hey, champ. [pause] Can I tell you something?
lines.text: Hey, champ. Can I tell you something?

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [softly] I don't care about the game. [pause] I don't know how to jump. I don't even know what a "noob" is.
lines.text: I don't care about the game. I don't know how to jump. I don't even know what a "noob" is.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [softly, sincere] You've been in that world for a whole year... [pause] and I just wanted to see it. With you.
lines.text: You've been in that world for a whole year... and I just wanted to see it. With you.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [quietly] ...You could've just asked.
lines.text: ...You could've just asked.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [small laugh] I did. [pause] You said, "Not now, Dad." [pause] About two hundred times.
lines.text: I did. You said, "Not now, Dad." About two hundred times.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: And then... at eleven p.m.... the alarm went off.
lines.text: And then... at eleven p.m.... the alarm went off.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [booming, alarm] Warning! The Block King has awakened! [pause] If the server falls... everything resets!
lines.text: Warning! The Block King has awakened! If the server falls... everything resets!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: The Block King. The biggest boss in Cube City history.
lines.text: The Block King. The biggest boss in Cube City history.

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.raw: [booming, echoing] CUBE CITY... [pause] IS MINE!
lines.text: CUBE CITY... IS MINE!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: He smashed the arena. He smashed Tycoon Valley. [pause] He smashed Granny's cookie factory.
lines.text: He smashed the arena. He smashed Tycoon Valley. He smashed Granny's cookie factory.

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [outraged] MY COOKIES!
lines.text: MY COOKIES!

lines.speaker: DARKBLADE
lines.raw: [panicked] Clan, attack! [pause] Clan? CLAN?!
lines.text: Clan, attack! Clan? CLAN?!

lines.speaker: NOODLE
lines.raw: [panicked] Bro, where ARE you?! We need you!
lines.text: Bro, where ARE you?! We need you!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: The server health bar was dropping. [pause] Ninety percent. Fifty. [pause] Twenty.
lines.text: The server health bar was dropping. Ninety percent. Fifty. Twenty.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [determined] Dad... [pause] I can't win this alone.
lines.text: Dad... I can't win this alone.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [warm] Then don't.
lines.text: Then don't.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [urgent] Mom! Grandma! The server needs us!
lines.text: Mom! Grandma! The server needs us!

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [stern] It's eleven p.m., young man. [pause] Bedtime.
lines.text: It's eleven p.m., young man. Bedtime.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [cold, focused] ...Five minutes. [pause] Let's go.
lines.text: ...Five minutes. Let's go.

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [cracking knuckles] Granny's coming, dear.
lines.text: Granny's coming, dear.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [epic] And for the first time ever... your whole family logged in. Together.
lines.text: And for the first time ever... your whole family logged in. Together.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [cheerful] Party formed. [pause] Party name: "The Family."
lines.text: Party formed. Party name: "The Family."

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [commanding] Okay! Mom, you're the tank. [pause] Granny, we need gear!
lines.text: Okay! Mom, you're the tank. Granny, we need gear!

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [proud] Swords for everyone! [pause] Put it on my tab!
lines.text: Swords for everyone! Put it on my tab!

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [battle cry] Kids! Formation! [pause] And wear your helmets!
lines.text: Kids! Formation! And wear your helmets!

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [fierce] Mommy's got you! [pause] Everybody behind me!
lines.text: Mommy's got you! Everybody behind me!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Mom blocked the punches. You led the attack. [pause] Even DarkBlade joined your team.

lines.speaker: DARKBLADE
lines.raw: [grudging] Just this once.
lines.text: Just this once.

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [shouting] Healing potions! A hundred of them! [pause] Family discount!
lines.text: Healing potions! A hundred of them! Family discount!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [commanding] Noodle, left side! DarkBlade, right side! [pause] Everybody, ATTACK!

lines.raw: [urgent] The crystal! On top of the obby tower! [pause] Someone has to jump up there and break it!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [panicked] I can't! If I leave, the whole team falls apart!
lines.text: I can't! If I leave, the whole team falls apart!

lines.text: Everybody was fighting. Everybody... except one.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [quietly, determined] Son. [pause] I've been practicing.
lines.text: Son. I've been practicing.

lines.raw: Dad. The man who couldn't jump. [pause] Versus one hundred floors of obby.
lines.text: Dad. The man who couldn't jump. Versus one hundred floors of obby.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [nervous] Space... bar.

lines.raw: [chanting] Jump, Dad! [pause] Jump, Dad!

lines.speaker: DARKBLADE
lines.raw: [shouting] Jump, Mister Hot Dog! JUMP!

lines.speaker: DAD

lines.raw: [shouting] JUMP, DAD, JUMP!
lines.text: JUMP, DAD, JUMP!

lines.raw: [whispering] For my son.

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.raw: [booming, shocked] NO! [pause] Defeated... by a HOT DOG?!
